source.title: Future-era career catalogue written for Prospero Companion
source.note: Everyday work in a future city, ship or station, for fiction; not labour statistics.

careers.name: Hull technician
careers.summary: Inspects and patches hull plating on rotating shifts, mostly from the inside.

careers.name: Reactor technician
careers.summary: Watches the reactor's readings and keeps its cooling loops serviced.

careers.name: Life-support engineer
careers.summary: Keeps the air, water and pressure systems in balance for everyone aboard or in the district.
themes: alarms that are almost always false

careers.name: Propulsion engineer
careers.summary: Designs and tunes engines and thrusters, and argues about fuel budgets.

careers.name: Shuttle pilot
careers.summary: Flies the regular shuttle runs between the docks and the places nearby.

careers.name: Navigator
careers.summary: Plots courses and keeps an eye on the long view ahead.

careers.name: Docking controller
careers.summary: Talks shuttles and freighters in and out of the docking bays.

careers.name: Traffic controller
careers.summary: Keeps the lanes clear for everything that flies in and out.

careers.name: Bridge officer
careers.summary: Stands watch on the bridge and signs off on the day-to-day running of things.

careers.name: Communications officer
careers.summary: Handles long-range messages, relay schedules and the occasional garbled signal.

careers.name: Maintenance drone operator
careers.summary: Steers repair drones through ducts and along the outer skin from a console.

careers.name: Robotics technician
careers.summary: Repairs and recalibrates the robots that do the heavy and dull work.

careers.name: Systems engineer
careers.summary: Keeps the computer systems that run everything talking to each other.

careers.name: Network engineer
careers.summary: Runs the local network and the relays that carry it further.

careers.name: Software developer
careers.summary: Writes and fixes the software that people use every day.

careers.name: Machine-learning engineer
careers.summary: Trains and tests the models behind the assistants and the forecasts.

careers.name: Systems analyst
careers.summary: Turns the numbers from sensors and records into reports people can act on.

careers.name: Security analyst
careers.summary: Watches for intrusions and patches the holes before someone finds them.

careers.name: Power-grid technician
careers.summary: Maintains the power lines, batteries and switching gear.

careers.name: Water reclamation technician
careers.summary: Runs the plant that cleans and returns every drop of water.

careers.name: Air systems technician
careers.summary: Services the scrubbers, fans and filters that keep the air fresh.

careers.name: Environmental controller
careers.summary: Sets the temperature, humidity and light cycles, and fields the complaints about them.

careers.name: Radiation safety officer
careers.summary: Checks shielding and dose badges and keeps everyone inside the limits.

careers.name: Materials scientist
careers.summary: Tests new alloys, fabrics and coatings in the lab.

careers.name: Astrophysicist
careers.summary: Studies stars and the space between them, and teaches a class or two.

careers.name: Observatory astronomer
careers.summary: Runs the telescopes through the night and logs what they see.

careers.name: Star cartographer
careers.summary: Updates the charts that pilots and navigators rely on.

careers.name: Ecosystem biologist
careers.summary: Keeps watch on the closed ecosystems of farms, gardens and water.

careers.name: Asteroid surveyor
careers.summary: Surveys rocks for ore and water, and writes up which ones are worth the trip.

careers.name: Ore processing engineer
careers.summary: Runs the plant that turns raw ore into usable metal.

careers.name: Cargo handler
careers.summary: Loads and unloads freight in the docking bays.

careers.name: Quartermaster
careers.summary: Keeps track of stores and decides what gets ordered and who gets it.

careers.name: Freight scheduler
careers.summary: Fits every shipment into the next available run.

careers.name: Supply chain manager
careers.summary: Plans how food, parts and fuel arrive months ahead.

careers.name: Rations planner
careers.summary: Works out what everyone will eat for the next season, down to the gram.

careers.name: Customs inspector
careers.summary: Checks what comes in through the docks and what goes out.

careers.name: Fabrication technician
careers.summary: Runs the printers and mills that make parts on demand.

careers.name: Machinist
careers.summary: Cuts and finishes precision parts by hand and machine.

careers.name: Pressure welder
careers.summary: Welds seams that have to hold air for decades.

careers.name: Habitat builder
careers.summary: Puts up new living quarters, module by module.

careers.name: Cabin fitter
careers.summary: Fits out cabins and flats with bunks, cupboards and wiring.

careers.name: Electrician
careers.summary: Rewires, repairs and installs, one call-out at a time.

careers.name: Plumber
careers.summary: Fixes leaks and blocked lines, where a leak is everybody's problem.

careers.name: Lift mechanic
careers.summary: Keeps the lifts running between levels, and gets people out when they stick.

careers.name: Recycling plant worker
careers.summary: Sorts and processes everything that gets thrown away, because nothing is wasted.

careers.name: Waste processing technician
careers.summary: Runs the plant that turns waste into fertiliser and feedstock overnight.

careers.name: Transit pod operator
careers.summary: Drives or minds the pods and trams that move people around.

careers.name: Transit dispatcher
careers.summary: Keeps the trams and lifts on schedule from a control desk.

careers.name: Hydroponics technician
careers.summary: Tends the grow racks, checks the nutrient mix and harvests on schedule.

careers.name: Crop scientist
careers.summary: Breeds and tests crops that grow well under lamps and in small spaces.

careers.name: Algae farm worker
careers.summary: Tends the algae tanks that feed people and clean the air.

careers.name: Mushroom grower
careers.summary: Grows mushrooms in dark, damp rooms and sells them by the crate.

careers.name: Pollination technician
careers.summary: Looks after the bees and pollinates by hand where bees cannot reach.

careers.name: Arboretum keeper
careers.summary: Cares for the trees and gardens that everyone comes to sit in.

careers.name: Cultured-meat technician
careers.summary: Grows meat in vats and keeps every batch clean.

careers.name: Food-printer technician
careers.summary: Keeps the canteen food printers fed, cleaned and working.

careers.name: Galley cook
careers.summary: Cooks for the shared canteen in big batches, three sittings a day.

careers.name: Head chef
careers.summary: Runs a busy restaurant kitchen and writes the menu.

careers.name: Baker
careers.summary: Bakes the bread and pastries before anyone else is up.

careers.name: Noodle bar owner
careers.summary: Runs a small noodle bar with six stools and a long queue.

careers.name: Coffee bar attendant
careers.summary: Makes coffee and tea for the morning rush.

careers.name: Lounge bartender
careers.summary: Mixes drinks and listens to people in a bar with a view.

careers.name: Brewer
careers.summary: Brews beer and kombucha in small batches.

careers.name: Nutritionist
careers.summary: Helps people eat well on what can be grown and printed.

careers.name: General practitioner
careers.summary: Sees patients at the clinic, from colds to check-ups.

careers.name: Clinic nurse
careers.summary: Works the clinic floor on long day shifts.

careers.name: Night ward nurse
careers.summary: Covers the ward through the night.

careers.name: Emergency medic
careers.summary: Answers emergency calls and gets people to the clinic in time.

careers.name: Surgeon
careers.summary: Operates on scheduled and emergency cases.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.summary: Makes up prescriptions and advises on what not to mix.

careers.name: Dentist
careers.summary: Fixes teeth and gently tells people to floss.

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.summary: Helps people rebuild strength after injuries and long trips.

careers.name: Counsellor
careers.summary: Talks people through hard times, an hour at a time.

careers.name: Midwife
careers.summary: Looks after parents through pregnancy and birth.

careers.name: Medical lab technician
careers.summary: Runs the tests behind every diagnosis.

careers.name: Gene therapy specialist
careers.summary: Designs and delivers treatments that correct faulty genes.

careers.name: Animal doctor
careers.summary: Treats pets and the farm animals, from cats to chickens.

careers.name: Care worker
careers.summary: Helps older people with their days, at home or in care.

careers.name: Schoolteacher
careers.summary: Teaches a class of children everything from maths to history.

careers.name: Tutor
careers.summary: Tutors students one to one, mostly in the evenings.

careers.name: Academy lecturer
careers.summary: Lectures, supervises students and tries to find time for research.

careers.name: Archivist
careers.summary: Keeps the records, books and history safe and findable.

careers.name: Nursery worker
careers.summary: Looks after small children while their parents work.

careers.name: Flight instructor
careers.summary: Teaches new pilots, in the simulator first.

careers.name: Heritage curator
careers.summary: Looks after a collection of objects and stories from the old days.

careers.name: Academy student
careers.summary: Studies full time at the academy, with a part-time job on the side.

careers.name: Security officer
careers.summary: Patrols, answers calls and keeps the peace.

careers.name: Investigator
careers.summary: Looks into thefts, fights and the odd mystery.

careers.name: Council clerk
careers.summary: Files records, issues permits and answers the public.

careers.name: District administrator
careers.summary: Runs the day-to-day business of a deck or district.

careers.name: Advocate
careers.summary: Represents clients in disputes and in court.

careers.name: Mediator
careers.summary: Helps neighbours, partners and crews settle disputes before they grow.

careers.name: Fire and pressure crew
careers.summary: Answers fires, leaks and pressure alarms.

careers.name: Rescue specialist
careers.summary: Goes in when something goes badly wrong, in a suit if needed.

careers.name: Census officer
careers.summary: Keeps count of who lives where and who has moved.

careers.name: Housing officer
careers.summary: Allocates homes and handles swaps and repairs.

careers.name: Shopkeeper
careers.summary: Runs a small shop that sells a bit of everything.

careers.name: Market trader
careers.summary: Sells from a stall at the market, rain or no rain.

careers.name: Electronics repair technician
careers.summary: Mends devices that would cost too much to replace.

careers.name: Accountant
careers.summary: Keeps the books for businesses and crews.

careers.name: Credit broker
careers.summary: Arranges loans and trades credits for clients.

careers.name: Insurance assessor
careers.summary: Inspects damage and decides what a policy will pay.

careers.name: Trade negotiator
careers.summary: Negotiates the deals that bring in what cannot be made locally.

careers.name: Recruiter
careers.summary: Finds people for jobs and jobs for people.

careers.name: Tailor
careers.summary: Makes and alters clothes to measure.

careers.name: Courier
careers.summary: Runs packages and messages across town by foot, lift and tram.

careers.name: News reporter
careers.summary: Reports the local news for the daily feed.

careers.name: Broadcaster
careers.summary: Hosts the morning show that everyone half-listens to.

careers.name: Session musician
careers.summary: Plays gigs and recording sessions, whatever pays.

careers.name: Immersive scene designer
careers.summary: Builds the virtual scenes people step into for games and holidays.

careers.name: Game designer
careers.summary: Designs games and argues about what makes them fun.

careers.name: Stage actor
careers.summary: Acts in the local theatre company and auditions between runs.

careers.name: Muralist
careers.summary: Paints walls that would otherwise be bare, on commission.

careers.name: Photographer
careers.summary: Shoots portraits, events and the occasional wedding.

careers.name: Club DJ
careers.summary: Plays late sets at the clubs and lounges.

careers.name: Novelist
careers.summary: Writes novels and takes odd jobs between advances.

careers.name: Fitness coach
careers.summary: Runs classes and training sessions at the gym.

careers.name: Low-gravity sports coach
careers.summary: Coaches teams in the sports played in low gravity.

careers.name: Pool attendant
careers.summary: Keeps watch at the pool and keeps the water clean.

careers.name: Hairdresser
careers.summary: Cuts and colours hair and hears everyone's news.

careers.name: Cleaner
careers.summary: Cleans offices, halls and shared spaces before the day starts.

careers.name: Concierge
careers.summary: Looks after guests at the front desk and solves their small problems.

careers.name: Tour guide
careers.summary: Shows visitors around and tells the stories behind the sights.

careers.name: Guesthouse manager
careers.summary: Runs a small guesthouse for visitors and new arrivals.

careers.name: Chaplain
careers.summary: Offers a listening ear and services for anyone who wants one.

careers.name: Event coordinator
careers.summary: Plans the festivals, weddings and parties that break up the year.
